steps.text: Rhodes Island Bridge 6:00 A.M.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Attention, our outstanding operators, I have some important information to report to everyone in Rhodes Island. This is Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As of last night, Rhodes Island has officially left Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In light of recent developments, the trade agreement between us and Lungmen has been cancelled. We no longer have any reason or standing to remain inside the city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Fortunately, we've already purchased a lot of supplies from Lungmen, which will sustain our operations for a while.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Unfortunately... Some of our operators will shortly be going deep into Chernobog's core city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: An extremely tough battle awaits us there.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Many may think that war is a distant concern to us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: War, they may say, is a conflict between two countries, and has nothing to do with a pharmaceutical company.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But war... I think war has never left us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have always been in a war. The long war of injustice against the Infected, the war that drives people to hate one another.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: To develop an effective treatment for Oripathy and give the Infected a chance to use it, our medics have poured countless hours into their research.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Likewise, it has always been our goal to provide the most advanced medical treatment to those here who suffer from Oripathy, inhibiting and slowing the progression of Oripathy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But that is far from enough. Before we can achieve these goals, we must face the ever-growing conflicts between the Infected and uninfected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The enemies of the Infected will not see them treated. And each crime they commit against the Infected aggravates the tensions between the groups.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All while others exploit and enslave the Infected for their own profit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are those who oppose us and even attack us, solely because we seek a cure for Oripathy... We have suffered this in the past.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Imagine... Imagine if we develop a medicine to treat this disease, but never have a chance to administer it to the Infected. What then?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our enemy is not only 'Oripathy.' There is no safety for us standing back from this war anymore.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Two weeks ago, Reunion and Rhodes Island engaged in a violent confrontation. Many of our operators sacrificed themselves in Chernobog.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...a story we have seen unfold far too many times.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But if every sacrifice demands vengeance from us, then we will be locked into an endless cycle of revenge. Countless lives... will be taken.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Taken by our enemies, and taken by our own hands.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our struggle with Reunion cannot rest upon hatred. If we are able to negotiate with them, we will demand from them an explanation, and hold them accountable for their actions.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Reunion is still gripped by their madness, even today. They have taken control of Chernobog's core city, and are driving it into Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even stranger, Ursus has not surrendered its territorial control of the core city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They retain a territorial claim on Chernobog, even with it under Reunion's control, even when Ursus never...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even when Ursus never took action as this entire incident unfolded. The Empire of Ursus ignored the atrocities committed in Chernobog, and made no effort to stop them whatsoever.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...They abandoned their own citizens.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This has led me to conclude that Ursus has conspired to bring about these events. A collision with the core city will spark an international war. A war between Ursus and Yan——

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: By then, it will be too late.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No matter who stands behind Reunion, no matter how hard they've pushed, no matter who the real mastermind behind all this is: there will be only one truth laid grimly at our feet.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ——'The Infected caused this war.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No matter the outcome of the war, the Infected will always be the scapegoat.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They will face even more brutal oppression, more miserable lives, and... an eternal, fiery hatred.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If that comes to pass, all Rhodes Island has done will come to nothing. There won't be a single country in the world that will allow us to treat the Infected, or allow them a normal life.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Indeed... this is an unavoidable part of our protracted war on Oripathy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island has always been fighting this war. And it's a difficult war to win.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But despite that, we will never give up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We will fight the fanatics with reason, and enmity with clever strategy. We will press on, because no one wants to see a bitter end to our efforts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So we will stop Reunion. We will stop the Chernobog core city from colliding with Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hope those of you staying here on the landship will look after Rhodes Island. Whether or not we return, Rhodes Island will fight on.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right. Situation normal.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Phew...

options: Great speech!
You make a charming orator.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, um, thanks, Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um? Doctor, is there something on my face? I didn't leave crumbs on it, did I?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Wait? What?!

options: Was it maybe too gloomy?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Yes, some other operators will think so too. They said, at times like these, we should be boosting morale.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I thought about it and realized we're not that kind of team. It's not about good or bad morale for us. We need to understand what it is we're doing.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The harder things get, the more we need to tell everyone the truth. We can't be making our decisions blind.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What could be more dangerous than walking around this world blindfolded...?

options: I heard Madame Ch'en left Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...It's true. I'm thinking Madame Ch'en will probably steal into the core city alone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lungmen, the Infected, her bloodline... Madame Ch'en is a complicated person, with a lot of contradictions tied up inside her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But even carrying around all that, she still didn't give up, she didn't run away. She carried it all with her into Chernobog.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's not afraid of betrayal, exile, or death.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, Madame Ch'en is Infected.

options: What?!
Huh...
I knew it all along.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, when we get to the core city, we're also going to do what we can to rescue her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not only because she... not only because Madame Ch'en is our friend, and not entirely because someone hired us to do it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madame Ch'en will not face Reunion alone. We will stand with her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everything she worked so hard to protect, and the painful silence she forced on herself... We will help her, because we both want the same thing.

options: Sounds pretty generous?
I thought you'd be more scared of that hard-ass.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, haha. Doctor, that look on your mask... it's funny.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've doubted Madame Ch'en before. I took her for the type who couldn't change.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But when she reached out to help the Infected, I saw it. I saw the color of her heart.

options: I've never heard anything like that before.
That's an interesting turn of phrase.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, err, it's just how I'd describe it!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't really know how to explain what I see... and it wouldn't be right to transmit it to people directly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But to protect the Infected in a moving city, to keep to that ideal is... heroic.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madame Ch'en isn't a cold-blooded person.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's stern and strict, but that's exactly why her sense of justice forces her to fight against the darkness in this world.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if she's never said so herself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So, we'll go.

options: Sure. I made that promise myself!
Okay.
There's someone else who wanted me to stop Reunion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Dr. {@nickname}, are you talking about...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Miss FrostNova...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...right.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And... Misha.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If there's something we can do to prevent a repeat of Misha's tragedy, to bring some comfort to FrostNova and her men, and...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: To help even more people, to stop the birth of new sorrow in this land, we will do it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've sent both of you the information.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This will be the first time the three of us have taken command together.

options: You're going to work with me?
Am I supposed to be excited?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You could always stay here. It's up to you. I can't force you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm listening.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I hope you can set aside whatever preconceptions you have of Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And I hope you'll set aside whatever prejudices you may have toward Dr. Kal'tsit, Dr. {@nickname}... from the things she's said before. At least for the time being.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname} has amnesia. Rhodes Island has no reliable treatment to restore the Doctor's memory in just two short weeks.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So everything that the Doctor is now is the product of new understanding and cognition.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, I hope you can look at this Dr. {@nickname} in a new light.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And Dr. {@nickname}, I don't want you doubting Dr. Kal'tsit's intentions just because of what she's said.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's the person that...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...you can rely on the most. Whether you trust her or not, she is.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please promise me, both of you.

options: What else can I do?
Looks like I have no choice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Water under the bridge isn't an option for us. Morality won't turn us into better people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not refusing your proposal, Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's just, forgiveness as a form of kindness, of waiving your right to anger, will only make us weak beyond measure.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will not waive that right.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But for now, I'll shelve my prejudices. Let's deal with the core city first.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Once and for all.

options: Amiya, I'm standing next to you.
Look forward to working with you, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right... okay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, it's not like I think that's a bad thing! I'm just... err, a little slow on the uptake.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I trust that you'll be there for me when it counts, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But what I wanted back before was for you to guide me, and take care of everything that I couldn't do in those difficult times...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I used to think that with the Doctor at my side, I could be brave.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, um... I'm okay, Dr. Kal'tsit. I've learned not to rely on other people anymore.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But Doctor, just the Doctor... I really thought like that.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Now, Doctor, we stand shoulder to shoulder. Ever since you came back to me, I've been waiting for the chance... to tell you... to tell you...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've grown up. I don't need you, or Dr. Kal'tsit, or... um... I don't need you to protect me anymore.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll get the results to prove that you were right to trust in me, Doctor. I promise.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hey! Shoulder to shoulder is just an expression. Don't call me short! I'm still growing...! Ugh! I'll be as tall as you in no time, Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I'm just happy, Doctor. Yeah... just... very happy.

steps.name: PRTS
steps.text: I am detecting a cold silence. Would you like me to raise the control room temperature a bit?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't mind if the Doctor doesn't want to share.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't want to pry...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I get it. We... we all need our own space.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's just, Doctor, even if it's just a little...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, you don't have to take that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname} has certain skills, and lacks certain skills. And skills need time to recover. Dr. {@nickname} will make the right choice at the right time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I hope that the Doctor has not forgotten everything that has happened since rejoining us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —If I can be allowed that hope.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, that's too much...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Doctor just doesn't like to mince words. I'm know you go straight to the root of the problem, right?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you're willing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I didn't think it would be this easy. Honestly, I was even expecting you to weave in some traps and pitfalls among your words.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...But what's the harm?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I look forward to working with you, Dr. {@nickname}.

options: What's the plan?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, yeah...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um, which part of the plan are you asking about, Doctor?

options: First, we'll need a way into the core city.
How do we get there?
We just walk up to Talulah and introduce ourselves, right?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island does have its own way of doing things.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Take a look at the report. I'll cover every part of the plan.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In four hours, we'll trigger a small sandstorm in the path of the Chernobog core city.
10:00 A.M., Wilderness

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Number one!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Compressor number one powered!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Number two!

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Ammunition stockpile number two ready.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Number three.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Wind pump number three, camouflage... camouflage in place!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Is the camouflage going to work...?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: The Chernobog core city command tower has a wide line of sight. This won't work without camouflage.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: They didn't even try to hide the fact that the core city was basically designed as a warship. The Empire thrives through violence and conquest.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Damn... So this is just how the Empire of Ursus designs things?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Designs put ideas into peoples' heads, and those ideas turn around and influence design. Living in an environment like this will breed a natural hostility towards outsiders, sooner or later.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: ...It's not fair to the ordinary Ursus civilians to paint them with such a broad brush.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Oh... um... I'll grab the backup cables.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: But, how many crimes did Ursus commit against my hometown? They'll never be able to wash the blood off their hands.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Now, they seek to use the Infected to spark their next war, to justify even greater cruelty against the Infected. Does this not prove their brutality?

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: They put the torches to our fields and choked our wells with ashes. They razed entire villages, leaving only charred corpses behind... They slaughtered the land itself. Only rubble remains.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Those are the 'ordinary Ursus civilians' I know. Had they not supported the war, none of these things would've happened.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I believe that was not the collective will of the people of Ursus, but rather the manifestation of evil ideas. We are not fighting the people of Ursus, but against evil itself.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Firewatch, this may not be Kazimierz land we're standing on. But still, we will not see those atrocities repeated.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: It doesn't matter whether the enemy is Ursus or not. Reunion may call themselves Ursus, or they may not. But we're not here to hurt people. We're here to stop people from getting hurt.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: ...The knights never helped us guerillas.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Our leaders waited years, but in the end, help never came. We fought to the last, alone, until we were devoured by Ursus. Not many of us are still around to tell the tale.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Who can I trust? How am I supposed to I believe in the benevolence of Ursus's 'honest folk?'

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I don't blame the knights. Especially not you, Nearl. But I keep thinking back to the time I spent fighting Ursus.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: I don't trust them, and I don't trust Kazimierz.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: That was a grave mistake on the part of the Kazimierz knights. A mistake that they could not right. And, they did not manage to protect Kazimierz.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: But at least, we can fight side-by-side today, Firewatch.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: I didn't have a chance to help you back then, but this time, we fight. Not for our homes, but to put an end to Ursus's atrocities.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Even if we're only here as support, I'm still prepared. To fight for what I believe in, to die for you.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: To die for someone else...

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Not all knights are like you.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: But I believe this is what a knight should be. There is meaning in dying for someone else.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Madam Firewatch, let this battle be my apology to you.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: ...Operator Nearl.

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Anything you need me to do?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Guard the area, until the devices are fully operational.
4 hours ago...

options: This is our disguise?
So we've already chosen our camouflage.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After so many major combat actions, infiltration is essentially a required course for our operators.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Every situation is different, but using the terrain to conceal your position is always a must.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sometimes it's snow, sometimes it's grassy plains, sometimes it's a swamp... we have different techniques every time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lungmen is here in the deserts and barrenlands, so use the sand to cover your tracks. That's the trick.

options: I'm not so sure about this.
That's not enough.
Maybe we shouldn't rely totally on this one tactic?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's just a way to cover our tracks. Rhodes Island isn't about unilateral operations. Successful infiltration is the sum of a lot of moving parts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The information the Azazel Clinic gave us authenticated the Chernobog blueprints I have. That means we have a solid picture of what the core city's lower levels look like.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When the time comes, we'll enter through the drainage system in the foundation. But we'll need bait.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We can't hook our prey without bait.

options: Same for the hunter.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Heh... Yes. You're right.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But given enough time, even the worst hunter can tell the difference between prey and bait. We'll have to stay out of sight long enough to prevent that.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: You don't need us to land for this op, do you, Instructor?

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: There isn't a good spot on the core city, and Reunion isn't exactly poorly equipped. They've got casters too. Landing would be trucky.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: No need. Just make it look like we're going to land, but keep circling the city.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We didn't bring a tactical team. Not much we can do with just the two of us.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Yeah, didn't think of that.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...How would you not think of that...?!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: J-Just kidding, Instructor. Put the whip down.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Hah... We got the wuss who flies the 'Bad Guy' and now this joker.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You can keep us up for a half an hour, can't you?

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Not a problem!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Just keep their attention! The Reunion element in the ruins knows we have aircraft, but we can't be sure about what their people in the core city might know.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Rest assured, you're riding the 'Good Boy,' and he's a lot noisier than the 'Bad Guy!' It'll be all eyes on us for a solid half hour. Just watch me, Instructor!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Careful now. Don't get us shot down.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Just sit back and relax, Instructor. I chauffeured Blaze and Ascalon around a hundred times and we never got shot down on any of those low flights.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...Getting shot down is a one time thing...
10:00 a.m. Core City Outskirts

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What's that...? Up in the sky?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: They're flying?! The enemy brought a new weapon! What country is it from?! Just shoot it down already!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We don't know what it's carrying. We can't let it land!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Don't panic! If it drops low enough, we'll light it up! Just don't let it out of your sight!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: What kind of safety features are on this thing?

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Are you afraid of heights, Instructor?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: A little.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Don't worry!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: If something goes wrong, we won't have time to react. The crash will pulverize us. Won't even be able to identify our bodies. The great equalizer!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: How could I not worry?!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Amiya, we've managed to distract the enemy. They're convinced we're preparing to land. Begin the operation!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Attention, combat operators! A smattering of enemies is approaching our position. Likely a recon team from the core city!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Our equipment is active. We won't let them ruin our plans. Madam Firewatch, cover me!

steps.name: Firewatch
steps.text: Roger!
